The task says "already has enough downloaded songs for it" meaning the album has enough tracks that are downloaded (is_offline true) to cover 20 minutes. So we need to find an album from the user's saved albums where the sum of durations of tracks with is_offline=true is at least 1200000 ms (20 minutes = 1200 seconds = 1200000 ms). Then we need to play that album.
